bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.26.tgz.why: Adds only: LAYER_BOUND and LAYER_RANGE on the console-manifest module, a bound and a range in the layer's version file and a range argument to onThisLayer, which now attaches every release from the bound up; nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.27.tgz.why: Adds only: an optional sidebarSection on the console manifest, defaulting to application, with CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_SECTIONS and ConsoleSidebarSection on the console-manifest module; nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.28.tgz.why: Adds only: FloatingWindow with the floating-window module, BESIDE_PAGE on the overlays module, ArtworkFrame and CardRow with the artwork module, the video player's optional autoNext and its next video card with NUDGE_SECONDS, NEXT_CARD_FROM_SECONDS and nextCardLead on the video module, and nine wording keys; nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.29.tgz.why: Adds only: the badge-ink class and a full-colour description on soft and subtle alerts through the layer's alert override; nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.30.tgz.why: Adds only: a word token for each semantic colour, --bmo-ink-<colour>, which the colour text utilities read and which falls back to the colour itself, and the word tokens badge-ink states; nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.31.tgz.why: Adds only: DateCalendar with six wording keys for its paging buttons; useOpenedWith with OpenedWith and OpenedWithOptions on the form-save module, which useCloseGuard, FormPart and SettingsDialog now accept beside the function or boolean they took; the floating create button kept under dialogs on a phone; one padding in a dialog head, body and foot; a form dialog holding changes asking on the back gesture; and Esc passing a date or time field segment through the reka-ui patch. Nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.32.tgz.why: A dialog's corner close asks before it throws a change away

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.33.tgz.why: Adds only: ChoiceSelect, the one select that searches once it holds more than seven choices or finds them over a road, with the choices module and four wording keys (common.placeholder.search, common.status.no_match, common.status.no_choices, common.error.choices_find_failed). Nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.34.tgz.why: Adds only: the design review fixes of ChoiceSelect (its list opens against the control's leading edge, a road's answer is awaited under a skeleton line) and a select menu's search field taking the elevated background while it holds the focus. Nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.35.tgz.why: A form dialog no longer asks to discard at an outside focus it refuses on its own, such as a menu handing the focus back to its trigger. Nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed: useCloseGuard still returns dismissible.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.36.tgz.why: An icon button gets the focus back as a menu, popover or dialog it opened closes

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.37.tgz.why: The one select takes a value typed into its search in free entry (createItem, the create event and the common.action.add_choice key). Nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.38.tgz.why: ChoiceSelect's list stands as wide as its choices and its control with the search field setting none of it, opens against the control's trailing edge where the leading one leaves no room, names every chosen value by its label whatever the words typed or a later road answer leave in the list, keeps a closing list's choices, and rings its control as a field; useListPreview follows the select's highlight (onHighlight, HighlightedItem); a finger's tap away from a list inside a dialog closes only the list. Nothing a bundle built on 0.1.0-rev.23 reads is taken away or changed.

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.39.tgz.why: Adds focusHandedBack to the overlays module; the page tooltip and the shared tooltip no longer open on the focus a closing layer hands back

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.40.tgz.why: Adds focusTakenOnOpen to the overlays module; the page tooltip and the shared tooltip no longer open on the focus an opening layer takes up on its own

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.41.tgz.why: Moves the layer to Nuxt UI 4.12.2 with reka-ui 2.11.0 and adds a Nuxt UI patch; ChoiceSelect's narrowed list moves as a moving list; adds MOVING_LIST, STANDING_LIST and narrowChoicesInPlace

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.42.tgz.why: Adds AvatarGroup, UnfoldingBox, the held-size and avatar-group modules, the moving list's sideways axis and one wording key; nothing a bundle of rev.23 reads changes

bmo-ui-0.1.0-rev.43.tgz.why: Stands every dropped list's rows on the 4px grid; ChoiceSelect closes a one-value list on free entry, awaits a screen's first choices under a skeleton and takes a choice keyed by the empty string; useOpenedWith take does nothing while the form is not standing; nothing a bundle of rev.23 reads changes
